_why: #18 part 4 / #26. Absence was silent in BOTH directions -- a cycle that gated a document either wrote a stamp beside every passing leg or it did not, and nothing said which. Seven live cycles emitted AUDITCYCLE: alone while audit_cycles stayed {plan:0, design:0, impl_plan:0} and the two-round cap was honoured by hand.

mutations.name: the-stamp-check-goes-away
mutations._mechanism: Back to the silence: a cycle reports its verdict and never says whether the stamp the verdict depends on was written.

mutations.name: an-owed-stamp-can-never-be-absent
mutations._mechanism: The failing direction. If absence can never be detected the token is decoration -- it says WRITTEN whether or not anything was.
mutations.find:
absent = [r.index for r in scored
                          if not _stamp_path(r.collected_path).is_file()]

mutations.name: not-expected-collapses-into-absent
mutations._mechanism: 'No stamp was owed' and 'a stamp was owed and is not there' must not print the same way. Collapsed, the loud token is as useless as the silence it replaced.

mutations.name: a-failing-leg-is-counted-as-owing-a-stamp
mutations._mechanism: A stamp is written only on PASS. Counting every leg makes a cycle with a genuine FAIL report a permanent false ABSENT, and an alert that is always wrong gets ignored.
mutations.find: scored = [r for r in results if r.verdict == "PASS" and r.collected_path]
mutations.replace: scored = [r for r in results if r.collected_path]
